page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-32-lssd is an arm64-based server instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance operates on a dedicated CPU allocation model, ensuring consistent processing capabilities without resource sharing. No GPU hardware is included in this configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture provides a balanced resource profile for general-purpose and compute-aligned workloads, offering a high density of physical cores per resource unit. Because this instance lacks local storage and GPU acceleration, it represents a streamlined option for workloads that do not require high-speed local scratch space or hardware-accelerated parallel processing.

This server type is configured for workloads such as web serving, application hosting, containerized microservices, and general-purpose business applications. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio supports multi-threaded execution paths, making it suitable for distributed systems, CI/CD pipelines, and moderate database hosting where external storage is utilized.
